title: Lego-style apartment transforms into infinite spaces
summary: A tour of Christian Schallert's 24 square meter apartment in Barcelona, designed so that it looks like an empty cube until he builds the furniture he needs. Kirsten Dirksen shows how the space is transformed for cooking, sleeping and dressing.
why: HN people link it as an example of a transformable small apartment in threads on micro-apartments and space-saving furniture.

quote.text: I like this guy's sliding lego house
